messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
Viscous friction force depends on angular velocity and the viscosity of the surrounding medium.
medium properties such as density and contact geometry set the damping coefficient.
coefficient and velocity define a damping torque that should be included in the physical pendulum model when air or fluid drag is not negligible.
negligible drag only in the idealized undamped vacuum case justifies dropping it.
